patterns: APPSC asks ISA and solar firsts as direct one-liners: Diu first 100% RE-by-day smart city, KUSUM not an ISA project, first ISA summit New Delhi.
Launch-year facts: National Solar Mission January 2010 (APPSC GS 2025); PV vs solar-thermal statement items (PV = direct light to DC).
AP angle: Ramagiri hybrid solar-wind park, AP ultra mega solar parks (Kurnool, NP Kunta, Kadapa).
Many filed PYQs are actually physics (AC/DC, transformer, latent heat) - the real solar-energy PYQ pool is small.
App MCQs are dominated by 2025-26 statistics (GW figures, ALMM lists, Surya Sarovar, BCD rates) well beyond the PYQ depth.
